# shoehorn_forge_molds (Data Source)

Retrieves all available Forge mold templates.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the Forge molds your tenant can use
data "shoehorn_forge_molds" "all" {}

output "mold_slugs" {
  value = [for m in data.shoehorn_forge_molds.all.molds : m.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `molds` (Attributes List) The list of forge molds. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--molds))

<a id="nestedatt--molds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `molds`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) The category of the forge mold.
- `description` (String) A description of the forge mold.
- `name` (String) The display name of the forge mold.
- `slug` (String) The slug identifier of the forge mold.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags for categorizing the forge mold.
- `version` (String) The version of the forge mold.
- `visibility` (String) The visibility of the forge mold (public, tenant, private).
